verified.note: Confirmed no FxRate schema existed before this change. GLLine and GLTransaction also absent. bookkeeping-multi-currency spec existed with different content (treasury-focused T3 spec) — this change adds the T4 GL multi-currency spec.
Spec file authored with Status:proposed, Tier:T4, Depends on:T1, MODIFIED REQ-GL-003, RENAMED, and ADDED REQ-MC-001 through REQ-MC-006.
proposal.md authored with Affected Projects, Scope, Risks, Rollback, Open Questions.
design.md authored with Decisions D1-D5 and Reuse Analysis table. status: pr-created set.

FxRate schema declared with schema:ExchangeRateSpecification, all REQ-MC-002 fields, x-openregister-unique on (transactionCurrency,baseCurrency,date,source,administrationId), x-openregister-preconditions requiring manualOverrideReason when source=manual.

GLLine schema declared with T1 fields + T4 multi-currency extension: baseCurrencyAmount, transactionCurrency, baseCurrency, fxRate, fxRateSource, fxRateDate. on-wire 'amount' preserved. fxRate defaults to 1.0. x-openregister-calculations declares isBaseCurrency and gainLossIndicator derived fields.
ECB daily rate ingestion declared as ScheduledWorkflow with interval:86400, openconnectorSourceSlug:ecb-fx-rates, invert-ecb orientation. No FxRateImportJob TimedJob authored.

Period-end revaluation declared as ScheduledWorkflow triggered on period-close. Note: x-openregister-lifecycle action for realised gain/loss on settlement will be added to T2 sub-ledger schemas when T2 is implemented; no T2 schemas exist yet.
IAS 21 translation declared as OR Mapping with monetary/equity/P&L rules referencing FxRate register. No ConsolidationTranslationService PHP class.

FX Rates menu entry added under Bookkeeping (order:20). FxRates index page with filterChips for transactionCurrency, baseCurrency, source. FxRatesDetail page. Both rendered by generic CnIndexPage/CnDetailPage.

FxRate entity entry added with schema:ExchangeRateSpecification. GLLine entry added with T1+T4 fields and reconciliation note citing bookkeeping-multi-currency MODIFIED REQ-GL-003. GLTransaction entry added. Entity count updated 225 → 228.
